# HSCA classes: HSCA-noVar, HSCA-var, HSCA-SV

Remake of the example-individual pie + class bar (panel f) and the per-sample beeswarm
(panel g) from `old-or-unused/merged-DSA-peaks.Rmd`. Every non-shared RE is
haplotype-selective chromatin accessibility (HSCA), named by its genetic cause,
from none to the largest:

* **HSCA-noVar**: accessibility differs, identical haplotype sequences (epigenetic)
* **HSCA-var**: accessibility differs, sequences differ by SNVs or small indels
* **HSCA-SV**: no one-to-one homolog on the other haplotype: the RE exists on one
  haplotype only (`Genetically haplotype-specific`), several copies merge into one
  consensus peak (`Complex`), or one haplotype's RE is < 75% the length of the other

The accessibility test (diff + Fisher) is taken from `union-peaks.Rmd` as is.
The sequence comparison is redone here (`compare-haplotypes`) and is meant as the
template for updating `union-peaks.Rmd`. It fixes two problems with the upstream
`has_het_variants`, which comes from a *local* alignment that counts only
substitutions:

1. Internal indels were invisible (a local alignment clips at the gap), so REs
   with indels were called HSCA-noVar.
2. Large length differences (`!sufficient_overlap`) were called HSCA-var; they are SVs.

Peak-boundary noise (staggered or offset RE edges between the two haplotypes,
e.g. from liftover) is ignored in two ways: an *overlap* alignment makes any end
offset free, and differences in the first or last `EDGE_FRAC` (5%) of the
aligned columns are not counted.

Reads `Tables/union-peaks-asm.bed.gz` directly. Unit is one RE per individual (a
consensus peak called on either haplotype). Autosomes and primary samples only;
`Untestable` REs are excluded from every denominator, as in `hdca.Rmd`.

```{r setup}
source("Rscripts/utils.R")
library(Biostrings)
library(future.apply)
```

```{r params}
EDGE_FRAC <- 0.05 # ignore differences in the first/last 5% of the aligned RE
MIN_LEN_FRAC <- 0.75 # shorter haplotype RE below this fraction of the longer = SV
HSCA_IN <- c("Haplotype-selective", "Epigenetically haplotype-selective")
# panel f example: a typical individual. HG02572 (PacBio, 6.56% HSCA) is within
# 0.01 points of the 39-individual median (6.57%); HG002 is the lowest (4.66%).
EXAMPLE_ID <- "HG02572"
```

```{r load-tables}
# union-peaks-asm.bed.gz from union-peaks.Rmd (symlink it into Tables/ if it
# lives elsewhere). fread(cmd=) spools the stream to a temp file, and the full
# table is tens of GB, so hck keeps only these columns and awk blanks `seq`
# except on the two HSCA input classes (the only sequences compared below).
UNION <- "Tables/union-peaks-asm.bed.gz"
COLS <- c(
    "is_peak", "Individual_ID", "Haplotype", "is_primary_sample", "Platform",
    "autosome", "consensus_peak_id", "haplotype_distinct", "diff",
    "has_het_variants", "seq"
)
HCK <- paste("hck -d '\\t'", paste("-F", COLS, collapse = " "))
AWK <- paste0(
    r"(awk -F'\t' -v OFS='\t' 'NR==1{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++){if($i=="seq")s=i; if($i=="haplotype_distinct")h=i}} )",
    r"(NR>1 && $h!="Haplotype-selective" && $h!="Epigenetically haplotype-selective"{$s=""} 1')"
)
union <- fread(cmd = glue("bgzip -dc -@ 8 {UNION} | {HCK} | {AWK}"))[
    is_primary_sample == TRUE & autosome == "Autosomes" &
        !haplotype_distinct %in% c("chrX", "chrY", "Untestable") &
        !is.na(haplotype_distinct)
]

# one row per RE per individual (both haplotype rows carry the same class/diff)
res <- unique(union[is_peak == TRUE], by = c("Individual_ID", "consensus_peak_id"))
res[, seq := NULL]

# haplotype sequences side by side for the HSCA candidates (all rows, since the
# haplotype without the peak call still has its sequence)
hap_seqs <- dcast(
    unique(union[haplotype_distinct %in% HSCA_IN],
        by = c("Individual_ID", "consensus_peak_id", "Haplotype")
    ),
    Individual_ID + consensus_peak_id ~ paste0("seq_", Haplotype),
    value.var = "seq"
)
rm(union)
gc()
```

```{r compare-haplotypes}
#' Count the internal differences between the two haplotype sequences of an RE.
#'
#' 1. Overlap alignment (end gaps are free, so staggered RE boundaries cost
#'    nothing), forward and reverse complement, keeping the better score.
#' 2. List every difference in the shared (aligned) region with its position:
#'    mismatches (two different bases, ignoring N) and indel events.
#' 3. Ignore differences in the first and last `edge_frac` of the aligned
#'    region (boundary noise), and count the rest.
#'
#' Positions come straight from Biostrings (`mismatchTable`, `indel`), which is
#' ~100x faster than converting each alignment to text and walking its columns.
#' Returns one row per pair: `len_frac` (shorter / longer length), `n_mismatch`,
#' `n_indel`.
compare_haplotypes <- function(seq_1, seq_2, edge_frac = EDGE_FRAC) {
    l1 <- nchar(seq_1)
    l2 <- nchar(seq_2)
    out <- data.table(
        len_frac = pmin(l1, l2) / pmax(l1, l2),
        n_mismatch = NA_integer_, n_indel = NA_integer_
    )
    ok <- which(!is.na(seq_1) & !is.na(seq_2) & pmin(l1, l2) > 0)
    if (length(ok) == 0) {
        return(out)
    }
    a <- DNAStringSet(toupper(seq_1[ok]))
    b <- DNAStringSet(toupper(seq_2[ok]))
    fwd <- pairwiseAlignment(a, b, type = "overlap")
    rev <- pairwiseAlignment(a, reverseComplement(b), type = "overlap")

    # internal differences of one set of alignments, as c(mismatches, indels) per pair
    count_inside <- function(aln) {
        n <- length(aln)
        start <- start(pattern(aln)) # aligned region, in seq_1 coordinates
        width <- width(pattern(aln))
        edge <- ceiling(edge_frac * width)
        inside <- function(id, pos) pos > edge[id] & pos <= width[id] - edge[id]
        # mismatches: absolute seq_1 positions -> position within the aligned region
        mm <- as.data.table(mismatchTable(aln))[
            PatternSubstring != "N" & SubjectSubstring != "N"
        ]
        mm <- mm[inside(PatternId, PatternStart - start[PatternId] + 1)]
        # indels: positions are already relative to the aligned region; one per event
        ind <- rbind(
            as.data.table(insertion(indel(aln))), as.data.table(deletion(indel(aln)))
        )
        ind <- ind[inside(group, start)]
        cbind(tabulate(mm$PatternId, n), tabulate(ind$group, n))
    }
    use_rev <- score(rev) > score(fwd)
    counts <- ifelse(cbind(use_rev, use_rev), count_inside(rev), count_inside(fwd))
    out[ok, `:=`(n_mismatch = counts[, 1], n_indel = counts[, 2])]
    out
}

# self-check on toy pairs: boundary noise is ignored, internal changes are not
local({
    ref <- "GGCATCAGTACGTACGTTTGACCAGTCAGTTA"
    toy <- compare_haplotypes(
        seq_1 = c(ref, ref, sub("TTTG", "TG", ref), sub("CGTT", "CGAT", ref), paste0("AC", ref), paste0("A", substr(ref, 2, 32))),
        seq_2 = c(ref, paste0("TT", substr(ref, 4, 32), "GG"), ref, ref, ref, ref)
    )
    # same, staggered edges, internal deletion, internal SNV, edge offset, SNV at the edge
    stopifnot(
        toy$n_mismatch + toy$n_indel == c(0, 0, 1, 1, 0, 0),
        all.equal(toy$len_frac[3], 30 / 32)
    )
})

# chunked so it parallelizes, with a live progress bar (progressr relays
# progress from the multicore workers as each chunk finishes)
plan(multicore, workers = 8)
chunks <- split(seq_len(nrow(hap_seqs)), ceiling(seq_len(nrow(hap_seqs)) / 2000))
cmp <- progressr::with_progress({
    p <- progressr::progressor(steps = nrow(hap_seqs))
    rbindlist(future_lapply(chunks, function(i) {
        out <- compare_haplotypes(hap_seqs$seq_1[i], hap_seqs$seq_2[i])
        p(amount = length(i))
        out
    }))
})
plan(sequential)
hap_seqs <- cbind(hap_seqs[, .(Individual_ID, consensus_peak_id)], cmp)
```

```{r classify}
res <- merge(res, hap_seqs, by = c("Individual_ID", "consensus_peak_id"), all.x = TRUE)
res[, is_hsca := haplotype_distinct %in% HSCA_IN]
res[, class := fcase(
    haplotype_distinct %in% c("Genetically haplotype-specific", "Complex"), "HSCA-SV",
    is_hsca & len_frac < MIN_LEN_FRAC, "HSCA-SV",
    is_hsca & n_mismatch + n_indel > 0, "HSCA-var",
    is_hsca & n_mismatch + n_indel == 0, "HSCA-noVar",
    # sequence missing for one haplotype: keep the upstream call
    is_hsca & has_het_variants == TRUE, "HSCA-var",
    is_hsca, "HSCA-noVar",
    default = "Shared"
)]
# accessibility-difference bins for the HSCA classes (DIFF_THRESHOLD = 0.25)
res[, diff_bin := fcase(
    abs(diff) >= 0.50, "50%",
    default = "25%"
)]
res[, .N, by = class][order(-N)]

# what changed relative to the upstream labels
res[is_hsca == TRUE, .N, by = .(upstream = haplotype_distinct, class)][order(upstream, class)]
```

```{r colors}
CLASS_ORDER <- c("HSCA-noVar", "HSCA-var", "HSCA-SV")
CLASS_COLORS <- c(
    "HSCA-noVar" = "#800080",
    "HSCA-var" = "#8b0000",
    "HSCA-SV" = "#f0a500",
    "Shared" = "#888888",
    "HSCA" = "#3b3b3b" # the total: neutral, so no subclass reads as the whole
)
# accessibility-difference shades for the two HSCA classes (light -> dark = 25% -> 75%)
SHADES <- c(
    "HSCA-var 25%" = "#e8888a", "HSCA-var 50%" = "#c0392b", "HSCA-var 75%" = "#8b0000",
    "HSCA-noVar 25%" = "#DA70D6", "HSCA-noVar 50%" = "#BF40BF", "HSCA-noVar 75%" = "#800080"
)
FILL_COLORS <- c(SHADES, CLASS_COLORS["HSCA-SV"])
```

# Panel f: example individual pie
```{r example-pie}
example <- res[Individual_ID == EXAMPLE_ID]

# Shared (grey) plus the HSCA wedge split into its three classes, so the pie
# uses the same colors as the bar; one label for Shared, one for the HSCA total.
pie <- example[, .(n = .N), by = class][
    , class := factor(class, levels = c("Shared", CLASS_ORDER))
][order(class)][, `:=`(ymax = cumsum(n), ymin = cumsum(n) - n)]
pie_labels <- rbind(
    pie[class == "Shared", .(y = (ymin + ymax) / 2, n = n)],
    pie[class != "Shared", .(y = (min(ymin) + max(ymax)) / 2, n = sum(n))]
)[, label := paste0("n=", comma(n), "\n", round(100 * n / sum(pie$n), 1), "%")]

pie %>%
    ggplot() +
    geom_rect(aes(xmin = 0, xmax = 1, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = class)) +
    geom_text(
        data = pie_labels, aes(x = 0.65, y = y, label = label),
        size = 1.5, color = "white"
    ) +
    coord_polar(theta = "y", start = pi / 2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = CLASS_COLORS) +
    theme_void(base_size = 6) +
    theme(legend.position = "none") # the bar beside it names the classes
my_ggsave("Figures/hsca-var-novar-example-pie.pdf", width = 1.2, height = 1.2)
```

# Panel f: example individual HSCA classes
```{r example-bar}
hsca <- c("HSCA-var", "HSCA-noVar")
example_bar <- example[class != "Shared"][, `:=`(
    class = factor(class, levels = rev(CLASS_ORDER)),
    fill = fifelse(class %in% hsca, paste(class, diff_bin), class)
)][, .(n = .N), by = .(class, fill)]
# 75% (darkest) stacks at the end of each bar, as in the original
example_bar[, fill := factor(fill, levels = rev(names(FILL_COLORS)))]
example_total <- nrow(example)
# legend: only the accessibility-difference bins that occur (light -> dark order)
bins_present <- intersect(
    c("75%", "50%", "25%"), example[class %in% hsca, unique(diff_bin)]
)

example_bar %>%
    ggplot(aes(y = class, x = n, fill = fill)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    geom_text(
        data = . %>% group_by(class) %>%
            summarise(n = sum(n)) %>%
            mutate(label = paste0(
                comma(n), " (",
                fifelse(n / example_total < 0.001, "<0.1", as.character(round(100 * n / example_total, 1))),
                "%)"
            )),
        aes(x = 0, label = label, fill = NULL),
        hjust = -0.1, color = "black", size = 2, show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
        "Accessibility difference\nbetween haplotypes",
        values = FILL_COLORS,
        breaks = paste("HSCA-noVar", bins_present),
        labels = bins_present
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous("# of FIRE peaks", labels = comma) +
    ylab("") +
    ggtitle(EXAMPLE_ID) +
    my_grid() +
    theme(
        legend.position = "top",
        legend.key.size = unit(0.2, "cm"),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0, face = "bold", size = 9)
    ) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1))
my_ggsave("Figures/hsca-var-novar-example-bar.pdf", width = 3, height = 1.2)
```

# Panel g: per-sample beeswarm
```{r sample-beeswarm}
set.seed(2)

# % of each individual's REs in each group: the HSCA total, then its three classes
GROUPS <- c("HSCA", CLASS_ORDER)
per_sample <- res[, .(
    group = factor(GROUPS, levels = GROUPS),
    frac = c(mean(class != "Shared"), sapply(CLASS_ORDER, function(k) mean(class == k)))
), by = .(Individual_ID, Platform)]

# median per group: a black tick on the violin, labeled above the top point
medians <- per_sample[, .(median = median(frac), top = max(frac)), by = group][
    , label := percent(median, accuracy = 0.1)
]

per_sample %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = group, y = frac, color = group)) +
    geom_violin(
        fill = "grey", color = NA, alpha = 0.5,
        adjust = 1.5, scale = "width", width = 0.6
    ) +
    geom_quasirandom(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5, size = 0.25) +
    geom_errorbar(
        data = medians, aes(y = median, ymin = median, ymax = median),
        width = 0.4, linewidth = 0.4, color = "black"
    ) +
    geom_text(
        data = medians, aes(y = top, label = label),
        vjust = -0.6, size = 2, color = "black"
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = CLASS_COLORS) +
    scale_y_continuous(
        "% of FIREs with HSCA",
        limits = c(0, NA),
        labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
        expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.12)) # headroom for the median labels
    ) +
    xlab(glue("HPRC Fiber-seq samples (n={uniqueN(per_sample$Individual_ID)})")) +
    my_grid() +
    theme(
        legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    )
my_ggsave("Figures/hsca-var-novar-beeswarm.pdf", width = 2, height = 2)
```

```{r summary-table}
per_sample[, .(
    median = percent(median(frac), accuracy = 0.1),
    min = percent(min(frac), accuracy = 0.1),
    max = percent(max(frac), accuracy = 0.1)
), by = group]
```
